opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Academics forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death, from any country. Some need postgraduate qualifications such as a PhD; others already hold doctorates and seek postdoctoral placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue mission providing temporary refuge for academics in immediate danger, securing postdoctoral or PhD placements at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) in partnership with a Network of 135 universities and research institutes. Cara checks applications, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
